steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: These munitions factories are all empty.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We hauled away two production lines and tore down the others.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The situation was dire. We didn't know how long we had until the Sarkaz mercenaries caught on to what we were up to in the factories. Otherwise, we could've taken even more equipment.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Highbury... This new industrial district feels rather different from the old district I was in.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: In Sudean, we were more like spanners, hammering away to knock together everything at all costs. But here... these production lines... I don't know. Maybe you guys are more like gears.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Turning ever so stably day in and day out.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We're used to it. That's how shocking human adaptability is.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Found it. It's here.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Why are there symbols carved on the collection boxes?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Years ago, our workshop used these as codewords to let each other know when to slack off. Never did I imagine they would one day come in handy.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Looks like workers everywhere just want to catch a breather, no matter the cost.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Let's see. Patto reorganized most of the Self-Salvation Corps from the other districts.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The Highbury safehouse was ambushed too, but a few of the pipelines deeper into the plate that's used as rest stops weren't discovered.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: They should be there.

steps.name: Rock-18
steps.text: I'm back~

steps.name: Rock-18
steps.text: I've marked the positions of all the Sarkaz sentries. There's not a whole lot of them. Looks like all the manpower in the city is either headed to the frontlines or followed the others.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Closure... I still can't say I agree with you installing your voice banks on my drones.

steps.name: Rock-18
steps.text: Hey, don't forget I helped upgrade this drone of yours!

steps.name: Rock-18
steps.text: Alright, enough chit-chat. I just heard from Ascalon that some of our communications systems might have been compromised by some Victorian duke.

steps.name: Rock-18
steps.text: I don't really buy that they can hack us all the way through, but just to be safe, I'm gonna run a whole security audit.

steps.name: Rock-18
steps.text: Feist, have you confirmed where the rendezvous point is?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: It's confirmed.

steps.name: Rock-18
steps.text: Awesome. Let's see...

steps.name: Rock-18
steps.text: We may have Shining as our super bodyguard, but she still has to take care of the wounded. So, avoid fighting at all costs, got it?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Rock-18
steps.text: You guys go on ahead and make contact with the remaining Self-Salvation Corps fighters first. Clovisia and I will work on the evacuation—

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Let's go, Rockrock.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Er... right.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: No, nothing...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I was just thinking... was Highbury always this quiet?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Going by the temperature in the air, there's no furnace burning in the neighborhood.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: That isn't a good sign. We need to act fast.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We should be able to make it deeper through this maintenance access.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Feist, it's me!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Tommy, you're here!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: You should've waited for us down there. The Sarkaz army has just cleared out our safe houses. There might still be patrols up here.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: I-I know... We suffered pretty heavy losses. Day broke his arm, too. Catherine gave him first aid.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: How much longer until the rest of your group gets here?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: They should already have left. Don't worry. There's a professional doctor among them. She will take care of his arm.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: A-Alright.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Our people are all at the lower level of Maintenance Access K13.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: I heard... the Self-Salvation Corps are going to evacuate from Londinium?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Only for the time being.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We will be back, Tommy. We're the Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: it's just that we need to get our wounded somewhere safe... and there are none in Londinium.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Now head on down. Catherine keeps it to herself, but we can all tell she's worried sick about you.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: Have you heard about what happened to Norport? Good gracious, the Sarkaz plucked the whole plate up and tossed it out of the city!

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: I heard that flying fortress even destroyed the a duke's high-speed warship... A high-speed warship!

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: War has broken out, Feist, but I've never truly experienced it before...

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: I used to think that joining the Self-Salvation Corps would be no different than before. I thought I'd be standing in front of the assembly line, turning screws, and the only difference would be that the weapons go to you instead.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: This... This is our home.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Of course, Londinium's our home, too.

steps.name: Londinium Worker
steps.text: We belong here and nowhere else, right?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: If you ask me, I think I've shown more than enough good faith already.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Hardly unexpected. We, too, have noticed the Sarkaz's secret transportation network for some time now.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: But it's true that there are certain details that are worth getting to the bottom of, and we will continue our investigation with a focus on these areas.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: And I have a decent guess as to who is behind... some of these events.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I hope you will share the results of your continued investigation with us.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Of course, just as I previously promised.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Rhodes Island's response is fast. Your terminals' signals have already been re-encrypted.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: If the opportunity ever arises, I would love to meet your engineer, Closure.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: She might not like you.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I must say, for a pharmaceutical corporation, your company is home to a variety of talents.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: That said, Her Grace has never been one to refuse new friends in lieu of making enemies.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Not to mention that Her Grace and Alexandrina are related by blood. She is more than willing to care for her young relative.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Please do let her know how appreciative I am of her looking out for me.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Your Royal Highness, I may yet call you so out of respect, but this does not represent my position whatsoever.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You can choose to call me Siege.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Victoria is a heavy burden, Your Royal Highness. It is nowhere nearly as vivid and vibrant as it seems on the surface.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The return of a certain person—no matter who she is or what she calls herself—is of no benefit to the nation.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: If, under certain specific circumstances, that person were to use her identity and influence inappropriately, she might even do the nation harm.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: That is my personal viewpoint.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Then you'd best keep your personal viewpoint to yourself.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm sure you know that my amenability of this peace between us does not equate to a tolerance of your cliches.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Your Royal Highness, there is no reason for this animosity between us. I am simply following orders, and I've more than demonstrated my goodwill within the bounds of my responsibilities.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Then perhaps your demonstration hasn't been very clear. That, or our definitions of 'goodwill' are different.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Wouldn't my suggestion that you should make your way to Norport count? If I am not wrong, you have a friend who is currently trapped there.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I thought you would see that I am very much putting myself in your shoes as I advocate for this partnership. I am doing you a favor.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: My goal is to obtain the schematics. You are free to do anything else you deem necessary, including rescuing your friend.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: If you would offer that blade in your hand, I could even offer my personal assistance.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You can save your disgusting hypocrisy.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Listen, I don't so much as want to think about what you and that duke you work for are scheming.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Stay out of my way, and get out of my sight.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And you better remember this. For what happened to Allerdale, you and I and your master still have a score to settle.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And you'd better believe it will be settled.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: I just got word that the Duke's special response team has already made all the preparations necessary for you to evacuate Londinium and board Norport Borough.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Let us be off.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. 'Trilby Asher,' since the moment I first saw you, when I realized just how solid of a grasp the Duke has on Rhodes Island's communications, I've been thinking...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You've always been able to do this, haven't you?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You've always known what everyone is up to, whether it's us, the Sarkaz, or the Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: It's nowhere nearly as simple or comprehensive as you would imagine.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: We've always found it very tricky to stay thoroughly informed on the Sarkaz, especially certain men of the Royal Court. Many of my colleagues have lost their lives because of this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But you've always had a good understanding of the tides.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why did you... and especially the dukes behind you let things turn out like this?

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: The Kazdel Regent is a formidable opponent, and my guess is even old Wellington would admit this. The Kazdel Military Commission's technology and equipment leave a deep impression.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: When coming from the executor of a Victorian duke's will, this just sounds like sarcasm.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Based on our analysis, Theresis may be formidable, but his strength alone is not enough for Victoria to fall to such lows, where it finds itself at the mercy of others.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And now I get it. You chose to do nothing.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You simply watched as the flames of war engulfed your country.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Amiya, the little leader of Rhodes Island. How old are you? Fifteen? Sixteen? You are still a child, even.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: You despise blood and war, but let me clarify this. We are not very fond of these things either.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: But to us, the objective of war is never war itself. War is an extension of politics. The Sarkaz needs a war to unite themselves, and Victoria doesn't necessary lack the need for one.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: However, around whom we unite is worthy of discussion.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And for just that, you—

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: This is very important. It is far more important than you could imagine.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: War is cruel. Suffering and death follow in its wake. It exposes our barest, truest forms to one another. It tears off all disguises.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: At certain stages of history's ever-forward march, we need this kind of honesty. All of us do.

steps.name: 'Trilby Asher'
steps.text: Now make your preparations, Rhodes Island. It is time for us to depart.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Molly! They caught you, too?!

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Lettou, she's just a teacher. The children in school still need to be cared for.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: You have already destroyed what you came to destroy. Must you drag even more innocents into this mess?

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: You're here, Your Excellency.

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: The Banshee came looking for trouble with one of us again.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I will send a unit to provide support.

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: No need. Taking a walk with him isn't so bad.

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: You should go to the Old Red-Eye. He had just opened a new bottle of wine, waiting for you, and we have already grown tired of his stories of yesteryear.

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: You are a much better listener than us.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: —Understood. Please pardon me, then.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: You...
Golding's throat has never felt this dry. The person in front of her looks and acts exactly the same as the Molly she remembers, down to the tiniest movements.
She is always frowning a little, watching every move of the mischievous children. At suppertime, she would hand out bread to everyone and chastise anyone who hasn't washed hands.
Her expression is the same as ever, but for some reason...
The drop of sweat dripping down Golding's back seeps into her clothes.

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: Lance scratched his thumb again yesterday, but don't worry. I've put on some ointment.

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: He's always such a handful.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: What... are you...?

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: The teacher has made it back to the school already. She will take good care of the children, I'm sure.

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: How about a chat?

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: Relax. It's just a chat. If you still don't feel comfortable, we can continue to use the identity of the owner of this appearance around you.

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: Why don't we talk about the weather first, or perhaps the children's studies? There is the play too, Lady Golding. Merely thinking about it brings tears to my eyes.

steps.name: 'Molly'
steps.text: The children have all grown so big in just the blink of an eye.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: Enough. Stop talking to me like you're Molly! Stop using that face, you monster!

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: What... What do you want?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Would you like a cup of tea? Lettou has pretty fine tastes, and his tea here is exquisite.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: We finally have a satisfying outcome for all the missions Theresis handed us. Now, we can take a short break.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: How long have you been around me...?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Not as long as you think. Can we skip the boring work talk, though?

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: It's break time right now. We want to do something that we are truly interested in.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: For example—

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: We want to know what you think about this era, and your conclusions around all this.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: I don't understand.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: You... You used me to destroy the Self-Salvation Corps. I should have no more value to you anymore.

steps.name: Golding
steps.text: I... Damn it! I handed all this out myself...

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Don't blame yourself. This is no big deal at all. We had all kinds of ways to locate the Self-Salvation Corps' stronghold. You are not the only lead we have.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: This may sound a little hurtful, but you aren't even the most important one.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: But we do indeed have a little bit of interest on you. We enjoyed your work and chatting with you.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: So, let's have a chat together. There is nothing more to this. It's just a conversation.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: We've had conversations like this many times. With countless of identities. With countless others.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: But we are still confused. We still don't want to give up any chances that could lead to an answer.

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: Lady Golding, how do you think—

steps.name: Damazti Cluster
steps.text: —we should live?
